# Sensilchem

> Sensilchem provides functional silica, specialty additives and silica-based adsorbent solutions for selected overseas customers across animal nutrition, food powders, oral care, agrochemical formulations, industrial water treatment, coatings, defoamers and plastic processing. Sensilchem supports material selection, sampling, application validation and reliable supply.

Sensilchem is a brand of Longyan Shenghe Trading Co., Ltd. (Longyan, Fujian, China), exporting functional silica and
specialty additives since 2009 under the CENSIL(R), Sensilchem(R) and SILSEP(R) brands.

Working method: start from the application problem, match a suitable material, drive adoption through
testing. Process profiling precedes quoting; documentation and compliance boundaries are confirmed
before shipment.

## Key facts

- Legal entity: Longyan Shenghe Trading Co., Ltd.
- Exporting since: 2009
- Base: Longyan City, Fujian, China
- Brands: CENSIL(R) silica, Sensilchem(R) chemical solutions, SILSEP(R) feed additives
- Certifications: FAMI-QS, SGS verified, ISO 9001, ISO 14001
- Typical first trial order: 200 kg - 1 tonne
- Website: https://sensilchem.com
- Sales contact: nina@sensilchem.com
- ICP filing: 闽ICP备19019250号-1

## Nine application tracks

- Feed Additive Flow & Carrier (Premixes · Vitamin blends · Trace minerals · Liquid additive powdering) — grades: CENSIL 260P, CENSIL 265P, CENSIL 280P
- Food Powder Flow (Seasonings · Powdered beverages · Soups · Dry blends) — grades: CENSIL 310, CENSIL 320, CENSIL 260P
- Oral Care Silica (Toothpaste · Oral-care pastes · OEM / private-label filling) — grades: CENSIL 310, CENSIL 320, CENSIL 150
- Agrochemical Carrier (WP / WG inert carrier · SC anti-caking and rheology) — grades: CENSIL 260P, CENSIL 265P, CENSIL 280P
- Industrial Fluoride Removal (Fluoride-bearing industrial wastewater · Polishing after primary treatment) — grades: CENSIL 320, CENSIL 310, CENSIL 500
- Coating Matting & Rheology (Wood coatings · Industrial · UV · Waterborne · Powder coatings) — grades: CENSIL 230W, CENSIL 525L, CENSIL 560N
- Defoaming & System Stability (Defoamer compounding · Coatings · Paper · Textile · Construction chemicals) — grades: CENSIL 17, CENSIL 698, CENSIL 688
- Plastic Film Antiblock (PE · PP · PET film · Blown · Cast · Biaxially oriented) — grades: CENSIL 773, CENSIL 779, CENSIL 185P
- Functional Masterbatch Dispersion (Antiblock masterbatch · Functional masterbatch · Compounding) — grades: CENSIL 165GR, CENSIL 185GR, CENSIL 779

## CENSIL grade index

- CENSIL 260P — Precipitated silica powder. Base carrier with a lower absorption gradient — the starting point for liquid loading, flow aid and anti-caking work.
- CENSIL 265P — Precipitated silica powder. Balanced absorption and flow — the middle route when a base carrier is not quite enough.
- CENSIL 280P — Precipitated silica powder. High-absorption, high-loading candidate for demanding liquid-to-powder conversion.
- CENSIL 310 — Porous silica-based material. Food, brewing, toothpaste and flavour stabilisation route with a moderate surface area and pore structure.
- CENSIL 320 — Porous silica-based material. Higher surface area candidate for food and oral care; also the preferred base material for fluoride-removal functionalisation screening.
- CENSIL 150 — High-purity fine silica powder. Fine-powder candidate route for oral-care paste structure and appearance work.
- CENSIL 500 — High pore-volume silica. Coating matting grade; used on the fluoride track as a high pore-volume comparison substrate.
- CENSIL 230W — Precipitated matting silica, specially treated. Waterborne compatibility and refined surfaces — matting and dispersion in balance.
- CENSIL 525L — Precipitated matting silica, organically treated. Resin compatibility, dispersibility and general-purpose matting for wood, industrial, UV, plastic and leather coatings.
- CENSIL 560N — Precipitated matting silica, untreated. Matting, rheology, anti-settling and cost balance for industrial, coil, powder and general systems.
- CENSIL 17 — Hydrophobic silica. Hydrophobic, anti-caking route for oil-based defoamer systems.
- CENSIL 698 — High-absorption silica powder. High-absorption candidate for liquid powdering in defoamer systems.
- CENSIL 688 — High-absorption silica powder. High-absorption route for liquid powdering and powder-system work.
- CENSIL 773 — Low-iron, high-purity precipitated silica. Antiblock and masterbatch candidate where film optics matter.
- CENSIL 779 — Low-iron, high-purity precipitated silica. Antiblock and masterbatch route for tighter downstream appearance requirements.
- CENSIL 185P — Precipitated silica powder. Conventional precipitated comparison route for film antiblock.
- CENSIL 165GR — Granular precipitated silica. Granular feeding and dispersion route for masterbatch production.
- CENSIL 185GR — Granular precipitated silica. Granular feeding and dispersion route with a higher surface-area position.

## Data policy

Sensilchem does not publish specification tables. Technical data sheets, specification sheets, COA and
SDS are issued per enquiry so that figures reflect the current supplier revision and are matched to the
customer's application. Request them at nina@sensilchem.com.

## Scope notes

- Agrochemical track: inert carrier material for physical formulation performance only. Sensilchem takes
  no position on active ingredients, efficacy or product registration.
- Industrial fluoride removal: CENSIL 320 / 310 / 500 are silica-based carrier candidates for
  functionalisation screening, not validated fluoride-removal products. No removal performance is claimed
  before customer water-sample bench tests and dynamic column results.
